name: list-invoices
description: Lists Stripe invoices, newest first, with each one's status, amounts due, paid and remaining, customer and due date. Filters by a customer id from stripe__find-customer and by status; unpaid invoices are status open. Each invoice id feeds stripe__get-invoice.

limit.description: Maximum number of invoices to return, from 1 to 100. Defaults to 10.

customer.description: Optional Stripe customer id, such as one returned by stripe__find-customer.

status.description: Optional invoice status. Unpaid invoices are status open.
